gloss: omission of courtesy; failing to send greetings

definitions.gloss: omission of courtesy; failing to send greetings
definitions.explanation: A failure or omission of an expected courtesy. Most commonly refers to not sending New Year's cards ({年賀状|ねんがじょう}) because one is in mourning ({喪中|もちゅう}). The verb is {欠礼|けつれい}する.

examples.japanese: {喪中|もちゅう}のため{欠礼|けつれい}します。
examples.english: I will refrain from greetings due to mourning.

examples.japanese: {欠礼|けつれい}のお{知|し}らせを{出|だ}す。
examples.english: to send a notice of omitted greetings

examples.japanese: {今年|ことし}は{父|ちち}が{亡|な}くなったので、{年賀|ねんが}の{欠礼|けつれい}をお{詫|わ}びします。
examples.english: As my father passed away this year, I apologize for omitting New Year's greetings.

notes:
Often used in the set phrase {欠礼|けつれい}{状|じょう} (or {欠礼|けつれい}{葉書|はがき}), the postcard sent in late autumn to tell people one will not send {年賀状|ねんがじょう} this year because of a death in the family.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {欠礼|けつれい}{状|じょう}: card announcing omitted greetings
- {年賀|ねんが}{欠礼|けつれい}: omission of New Year's greetings
- {喪中|もちゅう}{欠礼|けつれい}: omission of greetings during mourning

USAGE:
A polite, formal word; {欠礼|けつれい}する means to forgo an expected courtesy.
